questions.questionText: Mobile SEO refers to:
options: Optimizing a website for search queries from mobile devices
questions.correctAnswer: Optimizing a website for search queries from mobile devices
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Optimizing a website for search queries from mobile devices.

questions.questionText: Mobile SEO can be implemented if a website has:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A responsive web design.

questions.questionText: Responsive web design means:
options: Web content automatically adjusts to the screen size of any device
Content is fixed for one screen
questions.correctAnswer: Web content automatically adjusts to the screen size of any device
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Web content automatically adjusts to the screen size of any device.

questions.questionText: A responsive design serves all devices with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The same code.

questions.questionText: Why does Google recommend responsive web design?
options: It requires reduced engineering time and a single Googlebot crawl
questions.correctAnswer: It requires reduced engineering time and a single Googlebot crawl
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) It requires reduced engineering time and a single Googlebot crawl.

questions.questionText: AMP stands for:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Accelerated Mobile Pages.

questions.questionText: AMP is:
options: An open-source framework designed for fast load times on mobile pages
questions.correctAnswer: An open-source framework designed for fast load times on mobile pages
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) An open-source framework designed for fast load times on mobile pages.

questions.questionText: Features of AMP include:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Less JavaScript and CSS elements.

questions.questionText: Compressed images on mobile:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Decrease page load time.

questions.questionText: Mobile search terms are generally:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Short.

questions.questionText: Mobile keyword research is used to:
options: Identify keywords a mobile user might use as search terms
questions.correctAnswer: Identify keywords a mobile user might use as search terms
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Identify keywords a mobile user might use as search terms.

questions.questionText: Social signals refer to:
options: Engagement on social media such as comments, likes and shares
questions.correctAnswer: Engagement on social media such as comments, likes and shares
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Engagement on social media such as comments, likes and shares.

questions.questionText: Does Google consider social signals a direct ranking factor?
options: No, but they have an impact on rankings
questions.correctAnswer: No, but they have an impact on rankings
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) No, but they have an impact on rankings.

questions.questionText: Which search engine has a direct use of social signals, according to the guide?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Bing.

questions.questionText:
What percentage of content shared on mobile is done through messaging apps such as
 WhatsApp?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Over 77%.

questions.questionText: Local SEO is an essential part of mobile SEO because:
options: More mobile users search for local businesses
questions.correctAnswer: More mobile users search for local businesses
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) More mobile users search for local businesses.

questions.questionText: "Chess classes near me" is an example of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A local search.

questions.questionText: Local keywords include:
options: A location, such as "Italian bakery in Agoura Hills, CA"
questions.correctAnswer: A location, such as "Italian bakery in Agoura Hills, CA"
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A location, such as "Italian bakery in Agoura Hills, CA".

questions.questionText: Which of these negatively affects mobile rankings?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Crawl errors.

questions.questionText: Which Google tool provides a complete report on crawl errors?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Google Search Console.

questions.questionText: Too many ads on mobile:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Take away the content experience.

questions.questionText: The ideal base font size for mobile is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 16 pixels.

questions.questionText: Font size smaller than ideal on mobile requires visitors to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Pinch and zoom.

questions.questionText: Intrusive interstitials are:
options: Popup ads that block most of a mobile landing page
questions.correctAnswer: Popup ads that block most of a mobile landing page
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Popup ads that block most of a mobile landing page.

questions.questionText: Google does not rank high pages with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Intrusive interstitials.

questions.questionText: Small elements placed close together on mobile:
options: Can create a bad experience because users may click the wrong item
questions.correctAnswer: Can create a bad experience because users may click the wrong item
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Can create a bad experience because users may click the wrong item.

questions.questionText: A mobile layout should use:
options: Plenty of negative space around elements
questions.correctAnswer: Plenty of negative space around elements
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Plenty of negative space around elements.

questions.questionText: Mobile users tend to be more distracted, so it is better to follow:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The short rule (short content).

questions.questionText: A mobile sitemap provides:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Information about the mobile pages.

questions.questionText: A mobile sitemap helps search engines to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Crawl mobile sites more efficiently.

questions.questionText: Google recommends that a responsive mobile website should have:
options: A separate mobile sitemap submitted independently
questions.correctAnswer: A separate mobile sitemap submitted independently
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A separate mobile sitemap submitted independently.

questions.questionText: If a site has multiple mobile markup languages, one should:
options: Create a separate mobile sitemap for each markup language
questions.correctAnswer: Create a separate mobile sitemap for each markup language
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Create a separate mobile sitemap for each markup language.

questions.questionText: In which year did Google enable mobile-first indexing by default for all new websites?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) 2019.

questions.questionText: Mobile-first indexing means Google predominantly uses:
options: The mobile version of content for indexing and ranking
questions.correctAnswer: The mobile version of content for indexing and ranking
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The mobile version of content for indexing and ranking.

questions.questionText: Is a separate mobile-first index maintained by Google?
options: No, Google Search uses only one index
questions.correctAnswer: No, Google Search uses only one index
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) No, Google Search uses only one index.

questions.questionText: Is a mobile version of pages mandatory?
options: Not mandatory, but Google strongly recommends it
questions.correctAnswer: Not mandatory, but Google strongly recommends it
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Not mandatory, but Google strongly recommends it.

questions.questionText: Primary content on desktop and mobile should be:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The same.

questions.questionText: Both desktop and mobile sites should have the same:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Structured data.

questions.questionText: Page titles and meta descriptions for desktop and mobile should be:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The same.

questions.questionText: For images on mobile, you should use:
options: The same alt text as the desktop site
questions.correctAnswer: The same alt text as the desktop site
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The same alt text as the desktop site.

questions.questionText: Videos on mobile should have:
options: The same structured data as desktop
questions.correctAnswer: The same structured data as desktop
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The same structured data as desktop.

questions.questionText: If Search Console is used, both mobile and desktop versions should be:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Verified.

questions.questionText: The error page status should be:
options: Same on desktop and mobile sites
questions.correctAnswer: Same on desktop and mobile sites
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Same on desktop and mobile sites.

questions.questionText: Which is a best practice for ad placement on mobile?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Follow ad standards.

questions.questionText: Which statement about local SEO and mobile is true?
options: Local SEO is a Google penalty
Local SEO is irrelevant to mobile
Local SEO is essential for mobile SEO
questions.correctAnswer: Local SEO is essential for mobile SEO
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Local SEO is essential for mobile SEO.

questions.questionText: "Fitness classes near me" is an example of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A local keyword.

questions.questionText: Using local keywords helps the site:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Appear in local search results.

questions.questionText: The Search Console report on mobile errors helps:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Resolve issues affecting mobile crawling.

questions.questionText: Why is mobile SEO crucial?
options: Almost everyone uses a mobile to communicate and search
questions.correctAnswer: Almost everyone uses a mobile to communicate and search
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Almost everyone uses a mobile to communicate and search.

questions.questionText: Which design reduces the need to maintain multiple pages for the same content?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Responsive web design.

questions.questionText: Which is TRUE of AMP?
options: It helps simple mobile pages load fast
questions.correctAnswer: It helps simple mobile pages load fast
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) It helps simple mobile pages load fast.

questions.questionText: Which indicates that mobile layout may differ from desktop?
options: A mobile layout can differ but primary content stays the same
questions.correctAnswer: A mobile layout can differ but primary content stays the same
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A mobile layout can differ but primary content stays the same.

questions.questionText: On mobile, some content can be moved to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Tabs.

questions.questionText: Google crawls and indexes pages with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The smartphone agent.
